judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a definition-of-done file, a spec update, and a new failing acceptance test, completely omitting the actual implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` is untouched, the new acceptance test will fail immediately when `npm test` is run. Furthermore, the candidate did not update the `afterModelResponse` hook signature to clarify that usage is a total (`totalUsage`), nor did it add the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry. While the test and spec edits show an understanding of the requirements, the core feature and several acceptance criteria were left unimplemented.
